ads.title: Ad placements & policy
ads.subtitle: Decide where ads run, who sees them, and how often. Upload banner images under Banners.
ads.guideLead: If an ad is missing, check in order: ① master switches → ② placement → ③ audience → ④ banner creative.
ads.step1Body: Global on/off for the ad engine. If these are off, nothing shows even if placements are enabled.
ads.step2Body: Pick where ads appear (home bottom, records bottom, etc.). Tap a card to edit its policy below.
ads.step3Body: Choose free vs paid vs guests, and a minimum interval so ads are not too frequent.
ads.step4Body: See impressions and clicks. Zero usually means conditions are not met or no creative is assigned.
ads.guideBannerLinkAfter: . This page only controls switches, audience, and frequency.
ads.flagsHint: Turn on “All ads” and “CMS bottom banners” first for page-bottom creatives.
ads.flagsHintShort: For bottom banners, only the two primary switches are required.
ads.placementsHint: Tap a card to edit who can see it. Enable/disable turns that placement only.
ads.placementsHintShort: Select a row to edit audience on the right.
ads.policiesHint: Select a placement above first. Unchecking an audience hides ads for that group.
ads.minIntervalHint: 0 = no limit. Example: 60 shows at most once per minute on that placement.
ads.noPolicy: No policy rows for this placement.
ads.audienceFreeHint: Signed in without premium (usually keep this on)
ads.audiencePaidHint: Subscribers (turn off to reduce ads for them)
ads.audienceAdminHint: Turn on to preview as an admin account
ads.marketingNote: Note: CMS bottom banners usually require marketing consent. Users without consent may not see them.

flagHints.ADS_ENABLED: If this is off, no ads run regardless of other switches.
flagHints.INLINE_CMS_ENABLED: Needed for Home/My/Records/Machine/Community bottoms from Banner list.
flagHints.INLINE_ENABLED: Test-only slots without a real network. Usually leave off.
flagHints.NATIVE_AD_ENABLED: In-feed search placements. Keep off until ready.
flagHints.REWARDED_AD_ENABLED: Watch-to-earn ads. Keep off if unused.
